Lava Flow
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




1 ounce light rum
2 ounces pineapple juice
6 ounces pina colada mix
(coconut cream and pineapple juice)
1 ounce strawberry puree
1 small pineapple chunk for garnish

Preparation

1 Blend rum, pineapple juice, and pina colada mix with 1 cup of ice. Next, take a glass and coat the inside with strawberry puree. Pour in colada blend. Finally, use a spoon to drag the strawberry puree up through the colada drink, creating a pink stripe. Garnish with a pineapple chunk, and serve. 2 This recipe yields 1 serving. 3 NOTES :
